epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

basemessageuri.description: Reference to a base definition for this definition. Relative references are XIDs within the same registry. Absolute URIs reference message definitions in external registries. The base definition is overridden by this definition. If not present, this definition does not override any base definition

dataschemaformat.description: The schema format applicable to the message payload, equivalent to the 'format' attribute of the schema registry

dataschema.description: The inline schema for the message payload, equivalent to the 'schema' attribute of the schema registry

dataschemauri.description: The URI of the schema for the message payload, equivalent to the 'schemauri' attribute of the schema registry

dataschemaxid.description: Contains the xid of the xRegistry schema Resource entity associated with the dataschemauri referenced schema document. Note that this means the entity MUST be located within the same Registry.

datacontenttype.description: The content type for the message payload

envelope.description: Message envelope format identifier. OPTIONAL when no owning or referencing Message Group or Endpoint declares an envelope constraint; an unbound Message MAY still declare its own envelope. The available effective definition, after base Message inheritance or cross-reference resolution, MUST satisfy every applicable context: case-insensitive selector equality for a Group, or the Endpoint's envelope constraints with version refinement under the envelope's version rules. Context selectors are not automatically copied into Messages. If the effective definition is unavailable, compatibility is unresolved; this does not require Registry-side acquisition or target existence. The predefined envelope format is 'CloudEvents/1.0'

envelopemetadata.description: CloudEvents attribute declarations, adding constraints to the CloudEvents envelope not yet covered by the CloudEvents spec https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md

specversion.description: CloudEvents specversion declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#specversion. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

id.description: CloudEvents id declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#id. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

source.description: CloudEvents source declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#source-1. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

subject.description: CloudEvents subject declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#subject. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

time.description: CloudEvents time declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#time. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

dataschema.description: CloudEvents dataschema declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#dataschema. The URI of the schema for the event payload. Absence indicates no known schema. This attribute corresponds to the 'dataschemauri' attribute in the message definition and MUST be the same as the 'dataschemauri' attribute of the definition if present. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

datacontenttype.description: CloudEvents datacontenttype declaration https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md#datacontenttype. The whole declaration record is opaque JSON data; its members and their permitted kinds are defined by the common Property Definitions contract

mode.description: Whether CloudEvents 'binary' or 'structured' mode will be used

format.description: The media type format used to serialize the CloudEvent in the case of mode=structured

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

correlation_data.description: MQTT correlation data. This is binary data: its JSON representation is an RFC4648 section 4 base64 string, not a URI template. A declaration written against the earlier uritemplate typing needs the migration described in the MQTT protocol section

user_properties.description: MQTT user properties. This is an ordered array: entry order is preserved and the same 'name' MAY appear more than once. Each entry is an opaque declaration record with an additional REQUIRED 'name' member, defined by the common Property Definitions contract

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

key.description: The Apache Kafka key as a UTF-8 uri template. Mutually exclusive with 'key_base64'

key_base64.description: Binary Apache Kafka key as a base64 encoded string. Mutually exclusive with 'key'

headers.description: The Apache Kafka headers. The whole section is an opaque native-name map: each key is a Kafka header name and is the sole canonical name of that header. Each value is a declaration record defined by the common Property Definitions contract and MUST NOT carry a redundant inner 'name' member

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. This attribute MUST be the same as the 'protocol' attribute of the definition group, but is not automatically inherited because definitions may be cross-referenced across groups

headers.description: The HTTP headers. This is an ordered array: entry order is preserved and the same 'name' MAY appear more than once. Each entry is an opaque declaration record with an additional REQUIRED 'name' member, defined by the common Property Definitions contract

query.description: The HTTP query parameters. The whole section is an opaque native-name map: each key is an HTTP query parameter name and is the sole canonical name of that parameter, and its key character set is not constrained by the xRegistry map key rules. Each value is a declaration record defined by the common Property Definitions contract and MUST NOT carry a redundant inner 'name' member. Keys and values MAY carry RFC6570 Level 1 placeholders

path.description: The HTTP path as a uri template

epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

envelope.description: Envelope format identifier for common message metadata. If this Group declares an envelope, each available effective Message used in the Group MUST have the same selector, compared case-insensitively. Without an applicable Group or Endpoint envelope constraint, a Message MAY omit its envelope or declare its own. Group selectors are not automatically copied into Messages. The predefined envelope format is CloudEvents/1.0

protocol.description: Protocol identifier that defines the transport message protocol. All definitions in this group share this protocol type. Mixed-protocol groups are not permitted. Predefined protocol formats are 'AMQP/1.0', 'MQTT/3.1.1', 'MQTT/5.0', 'KAFKA', 'HTTP', and 'NATS'
